MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Samsung SSD feels useful because it would make file transfers easier alongside my older desktop hard drive and card reader.",
    "The Bluetooth and USB adapters connect with my repeated interest in keeping computer peripherals working together, while the Fire TV and Echo suggestions recognize my existing Alexa setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Headphones and earbuds do not address a current need for me; buying speakers and computer accessories does not mean I am looking for personal listening devices.",
    "The liquid cooler assumes a PC-building project I have not shown, and the tablet assumes a need for another entertainment device.",
    "An older Echo Dot and another Fire TV Stick offer little immediate benefit after my newer Dot, Echo Show, and Fire TV Stick 4K Max purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any electronic device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Previous purchases seem to be treated as reasons to buy similar products again, without enough attention to whether I have already filled that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Useful additions to equipment I already own matter more to me right now than another device that repeats what my recent purchases do.",
    "Compatibility matters: USB-C adapters would only help if my computer has the right ports, and another Bluetooth adapter needs a reason to replace my existing one.",
    "Storage capacity and portability solve different problems: the small SSD offers a clear file-transfer use, while a 16TB drive would require a storage shortage I have not indicated."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical accessories and Alexa devices, but miss the difference between a useful addition and a need I have already covered."
}
